# Gantt / timeline

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Project timeline: adaptive calendar, activity spans, cadence rows, events, and elapsed-time context. Type `gantt`. Aliases: `timeline`.

## Use cases

- Project plan with milestones
- Rollout by workstream
- Campaign calendar

## Chart IDs

One form; its chart ID is `gantt`.

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "gantt",
  "data": {
    "rows": [
      {
        "id": "design",
        "label": "Design",
        "items": [{ "id": "design-bar", "kind": "bar", "start": "2026-04-01", "end": "2026-04-10" }]
      },
      {
        "id": "launch",
        "label": "Launch",
        "items": [{ "id": "launch-date", "kind": "milestone", "start": "2026-04-15" }]
      }
    ]
  },
  "options": { "title": "Design ends five days before launch", "source": "Illustrative data" }
}
```

## Data

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| rows | array | yes | Task and cadence rows displayed in the supplied order. |
| rows[].id (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Unique timeline row identity. |
| rows[].label (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Visible timeline row name. |
| rows[].sublabel (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Second line under the row name, such as what the row measures. Printed in the label font and muted ink, on one line and never cut; the name band takes the wider of name and sublabel. On narrow canvases it follows the name on the row's name line. labels.activity: false hides it with the name. |
| rows[].indent (rows[] branch 1) | integer |  | Nonnegative indentation level for the row label. |
| rows[].cols (rows[] branch 1) | array |  | Metadata columns beside the row label, such as owner and status; up to three are displayed. A cell is text, or text with a tone. |
| rows[].cols[].text (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Cell text, such as a status word. |
| rows[].cols[].tone (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Status tone; omitted, the cell is plain text. A tone is drawn as a small filled marker in the tone's colour before the text. The row's bars and chevrons without a colorRole take the same colour, as do those of rows indented under it without a status, so the status column keys them. One of `'good'`, `'warn'`, `'bad'`, `'neutral'`. |
| rows[].kind (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Task row containing individual timeline items; task is the default row kind. One of `'task'`. |
| rows[].items (rows[] branch 1) | array | yes | Timeline items placed in this task row. |
| rows[].items[].id (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Unique item identity used by annotations and scene elements. |
| rows[].items[].kind (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Timeline mark. Milestone labels try their row bands before the lane; unsafe leaders use a numbered key. 'rule' is a quiet span for the state before a change: a 2 px neutral line at the bottom of the bar box with its label above it in muted ink, flush left; it never takes a colour or a colour-key entry. One of `'bar'`, `'milestone'`, `'chevron'`, `'bracket'`, `'shade'`, `'rule'`. |
| rows[].items[].start (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | ISO 8601 start date; an anchor can move it while preserving duration. |
| rows[].items[].end (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Inclusive ISO 8601 end date for an interval; omission uses the start date. |
| rows[].items[].label (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Displayed item name. An omitted name leaves category content empty. |
| rows[].items[].colorRole (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Theme color role for this timeline mark. One of good, bad, warn, neutral, neutralLight, highlight, total, others; series-N for step N of the theme ramp, 1-based (series-2 is color.series[1]); or status-<key> for a theme status colour. A hex colour goes in fill. |
| rows[].items[].colorLabel (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | What this bar's or chevron's colour means. When bars differ in colour, the colour key names each colour by the first label its items declare. legend.order lists item ids; an entry takes the place of the first of its items listed. |
| rows[].items[].scope (rows[] branch 1) | string |  | Milestone scope: 'row' (default) keeps the milestone in its activity row; 'shared' moves it to one shared milestone row below the activities, labelled beside its diamond, for dates that affect several activities such as steering committees. One of `'row'`, `'shared'`. |
| rows[].items[].anchor (rows[] branch 1) | object |  | Resolve the start relative to another item edge while preserving the authored duration. |
| rows[].items[].anchor.toItemId (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Target item id whose start or end anchors this item. |
| rows[].items[].anchor.edge (rows[] branch 1) | string | yes | Target edge used to resolve the anchored start date. One of `'start'`, `'end'`. |
| rows[].items[].anchor.offsetDays (rows[] branch 1) | integer |  | Signed number of days added to the target edge; defaults to zero. |
| rows[].id (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | Unique timeline row identity. |
| rows[].label (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | Visible timeline row name. |
| rows[].sublabel (rows[] branch 2) | string |  | Second line under the row name, such as what the row measures. Printed in the label font and muted ink, on one line and never cut; the name band takes the wider of name and sublabel. On narrow canvases it follows the name on the row's name line. labels.activity: false hides it with the name. |
| rows[].indent (rows[] branch 2) | integer |  | Nonnegative indentation level for the row label. |
| rows[].cols (rows[] branch 2) | array |  | Metadata columns beside the row label, such as owner and status; up to three are displayed. A cell is text, or text with a tone. |
| rows[].cols[].text (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | Cell text, such as a status word. |
| rows[].cols[].tone (rows[] branch 2) | string |  | Status tone; omitted, the cell is plain text. A tone is drawn as a small filled marker in the tone's colour before the text. The row's bars and chevrons without a colorRole take the same colour, as do those of rows indented under it without a status, so the status column keys them. One of `'good'`, `'warn'`, `'bad'`, `'neutral'`. |
| rows[].kind (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | Cadence row showing repeated dated event markers. One of `'cadence'`. |
| rows[].events (rows[] branch 2) | array | yes | Dated events placed along this cadence row. |
| rows[].events[].id (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | Unique event identity shared with the timeline mark id namespace. |
| rows[].events[].date (rows[] branch 2) | string | yes | ISO 8601 date of the cadence event. |
| rows[].marker (rows[] branch 2) | string |  | Cadence event shape; defaults to diamond. One of `'diamond'`, `'triangle'`. |
| rows[].colorRole (rows[] branch 2) | string |  | Theme color role shared by the cadence markers. One of good, bad, warn, neutral, neutralLight, highlight, total, others; series-N for step N of the theme ramp, 1-based (series-2 is color.series[1]); or status-<key> for a theme status colour. A hex colour goes in fill. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| labels | false \| object | `false` (or another value of its type) |  | False hides timeline item labels. Row names, metadata cells and column headers remain. Use labels.activity: false to hide those, or labels.item: false to hide only item labels. For milestones, labels.item: ['category'] prints the item name without its date; ['absolute'] or the legacy ['value'] prints only the date. Span items print the inclusive date range. Parts follow the supplied order. An empty requested part is named in a note. |
| today | string |  |  | Authored ISO 8601 date for the dashed today marker; the system clock is not read. The marker, like an event rule, passes the period names of the calendar head with a gap. A bar, arrow or shade name with no seat clear of the marker and the event rules sits inside its mark across them, and the rules break over that mark. |
| elapsed | boolean |  |  | Tint the visible time before today; defaults to true when the today marker is displayed. |
| weekends | boolean |  |  | Shade Saturday and Sunday at week granularity; defaults to false. |
| rowTint | boolean |  |  | Apply alternating faint row backgrounds; defaults to false. |
| colHeaders | array |  |  | Positional headers for up to three existing metadata columns. Omitted or empty entries have no header; entries without a displayed column are ignored. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `detailFields`, `categoryLabels`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`.

## Annotations

An annotation anchor is a category or item id string, or an object with categoryId plus optional seriesId, segmentId and edge (start, end, total); pointId addresses a scatter point. Category anchors, including from/to, take category ids, not category labels.

| Kind | Purpose | Required | Anchors | Optional fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event | Places a dated event in the lane above the plot as a block with a pole to the data, or, when it does not fit, as a numbered marker with an entry in the event key below the plot; periods draw a thin bar. | at, label | at: AnchorRef | tone: neutral \| bad \| good, default the group tone, else neutral. Column, combo and line paint the glyph, the marker ring and the period bar in it; gantt paints a bad rule. labelPlacement: top \| inline \| badge, default top. inline (line) sets the block beside its rule inside the plot. badge (gantt) draws the label, at most 3 characters, in a filled circle at the top of its rule; badge events never go to the numbered key. | An ISO date or a schedule item id positions the rule. Above three events the labels move to numbered footnotes. |

## Sizing

Floor 280 × 28 px; fit `content`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).

## Not for

Steps without dates; gantt places spans and events on a calendar.
